_readme: THE arbiter of how an integer paisa value becomes a string a human reads.
This file is loaded by TWO stacks: MoneyDisplayAuthorityTest (JVM, via the shared-lib test
relative import). Neither stack owns it. Change a display rule on one side and the other
side's test goes red, which is the entire point — see 37-01-PLAN.md.
'paisa' is a JSON STRING on purpose. A JSON parser coerces a bare number to an IEEE-754
double, which loses the 2^53 vector precisely where it is being asserted.

vectors.name: zero still shows its minor unit
a single paisa is not rounded away
a whole rupee keeps two places so a column aligns
a non-zero minor unit survives (the 56-paisa defect)
negative takes a leading sign, ahead of the prefix
beyond 2^53 paisa — exact, so no double is on the path
far beyond 2^53, near the long ceiling
